_comment: NEXUS Orchestrator runtime config — edit here, never in orchestrator.js

heal._comment: Single source of truth for self-healing. Replaces NEXUS_HEAL_DRY and NEXUS_FORGE_APPLY env vars — those are now ignored if this block is present.

_ports_comment: Single source of truth for system->port. Sovereign systems resolve each other through lib/nexus-client.js, never a hardcoded port. NOTE: 'ollama' is the NEXUS ollama-bridge (:3749), NOT the ollama daemon (:11434) — this key previously said 11434, which contradicted orchestrator.js's SYS map. Nothing read it, so nothing broke; fixed here before anything started depending on it.
